review.protocol: nPOD DNeasy DNA extraction from tissue (lysis reagent additions)
assumptions: 4 samples, one tissue sample per 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube (sample_1 to sample_4), handled by channels 0-3; the protocol does not say how many samples
Sample tubes sit in a tube rack on the deck and are taken off and put back for vortexing and incubation

Buffer ATL, Buffer AL and 100% ethanol are each loaded into their own small trough so 4 channels can draw at once; proteinase K is loaded into a 1 mL tube to save enzyme and drawn one channel at a time

The library has no labware for DNeasy Mini spin columns or collection tubes, so moving the lysate onto the column (all of the mixture, about 600 µl) and adding Buffer AW1, Buffer AW2 and 1x Tris-EDTA are manual pipetting steps at the protocol's volumes
300 uL filter tips (on deck) are used for the 180 and 200 uL additions, and 50 uL filter tips for the 20 uL proteinase K additions; the SOP calls for filter tips
Placing, weighing and mincing the tissue (1.1-1.1.2) is done before the run; quantification and storage (1.15, section 4) come after it and are not in the listed requirements
Fresh tips are used for each reagent; the tips touch only the reagent and are dispensed above the tissue

manual_steps.instruction: Cap sample tubes 1-4, take them off the deck and mix thoroughly by vortexing.

Incubate sample tubes 1-4 at 56°C in a hybridization oven with moderate rotation until the tissue is completely lysed. Vortex well every 30 minutes. Check level of digestion at 2 hours; if digestion is incomplete, continue 1-2 more hours. Then put the tubes back in their deck positions, uncapped.
Take sample tubes 1-4 off the deck, vortex each for 15 seconds, then put them back in their deck positions, uncapped.
Cap sample tubes 1-4, take them off the deck and vortex thoroughly, then put them back in their deck positions, uncapped.
Cap sample tubes 1-4, take them off the deck and vortex again.
For each of samples 1-4, place a DNeasy Mini spin column in a 2 ml collection tube and pipette all of the mixture (about 600 µl) into it.
Centrifuge the spin columns at ≥6000 x g for 1 minute. Discard flow-through and collection tube.
Place each DNeasy Mini spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube and add 500 µl Buffer AW1 to the column.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at ≥6000 x g. Discard flow-through and collection tube.
Place each DNeasy column in a new 2 ml collection tube and add 500 µl Buffer AW2.
Centrifuge for 3 minutes at 20,000 x g to dry the DNeasy membrane. Discard flow-through and collection tube.
Place each DNeasy Mini spin column in a new 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and add 100 µl 1x Tris-EDTA buffer to the center of the spin column membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes and then centrifuge for 1 minute at ≥6000 x g to elute DNA.
